## Activación entre tipos de frontera
A need or capacity in one territory, community or technical domain can open another possibility.

relations.reading: Distributed American Innovation offers a field-oriented lens on how territorial, social and technical frontiers can activate one another through operating networks.

relations.title: Adaptación de arquitectura entre territorios
relations.reading: The Tuxpan mobility account illustrates cross-frontier activation through adaptation: experience from different operating worlds informed a locally constrained architecture.

relations.title: Evidencia de contribución
relations.reading: Cross-frontier activation can also run from field constraints to research questions, provided later formalization is kept separate from validation of the original cases.

relations.title: Preestandarización
relations.reading: The extensible case-study method could translate a frontier observation into a bounded requirement and test, rather than treating experience itself as a standard.

relations.title: Capacidad reutilizable
relations.reading: A mobility orchestration capability can travel between domains only if the receiving context’s actors, obligations and constraints are made explicit.

relations.title: Condiciones de activación de capacidad
relations.reading: The frontier-activation essay suggests a further study of how conditions at one interface enable another, with each capability and observation level defined separately.

relations.title: Existencia, encuentro y oportunidad ejecutable
relations.reading: Cross-frontier activation needs an observed encounter and a justified capability link; a shared mathematical region alone does not supply either.
